subject: Confirmation and timeline for full prompt-output & telemetry purge
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@fastbank.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Cc: compliance@fastbank.com
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: purge of tenant prompt/response artifacts and related telemetry

Hi Jordan,

Per our data-residency and retention policy review, FastBank needs Redwood to execute a complete purge of all prompt inputs, assistant outputs, and associated request/response telemetry tied to our tenant 'fastbank-prod' (all environments) going back to Jan 1, 2025.

Requirements:
- Permanent removal of prompt/output logs and KV cache snapshots referencing customer identifiers.
- Confirmation of deletion provenance (manifest + audit log entries).
- Redaction report for any derivative artifacts (embeddings, indexes).
- ETA for completion and single-point contact for proof delivery.

This is a compliance action; please confirm next steps and estimated timeline.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Data Protection
FastBank

Attachment: (none in this initial message)
From: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@fastbank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of tenant prompt/response artifacts and related telemetry

Elena — thank you for the clear scope. I’ve looped in Marissa (Customer Ops) to run the purge and Lauren (Privacy) to validate the compliance artifacts.

Quick summary of our proposed workflow:
1) Intake validation: ops to run a scoped query for 'fastbank-prod' identifiers and produce an erasure_manifest.csv for your review.
2) Staged execution: low-risk window run that deletes prompt/output logs and associated KV caches; embeddings/indexes flagged for redaction or rebuild.
3) Proof bundle: redaction_report.pdf + immutable manifest + system audit entries (timestamps, operator IDs).
4) Delivery: secure share + DocuSign confirmation that satisfies your retention policy.

Marissa — can you confirm a 72-hour ETA for the intake validation and estimated total window?

Elena — are there any friction points (e.g., legal sign-off or SSO user tokens) we should be aware of before starting?

—Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, Elena Ruiz <elena@fastbank.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-28T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of tenant prompt/response artifacts and related telemetry

Thanks Jordan. Elena — taking ownership of the run. Operational notes and proposed timeline: 
- Intake (T+0 to T+2 business days): produce erasure_manifest.csv listing object ids, storage paths, and last-seen timestamps (CSV will omit sensitive tokens).
- Dry-run (T+3): ops will run a non-destructive dry-run that simulates deletions and outputs the list of affected shards/keys for your verification. Dry-run report available for review within 24 hrs of completion.
- Execution window (T+5 to T+6): scheduled block to perform irreversible deletions during a low-traffic window (we recommend 01:00–05:00 UTC).
- Proof delivery (T+6 to T+7): redaction_report.pdf and immutable audit entries delivered to a secure Drive folder and cross-signed via DocuSign.

Attachments we will produce: erasure_manifest.csv, redaction_report.pdf, and an ops_ticket_export.json (for internal trace).

Constraints/notes:
- Embeddings/indices: we will provide a flagging report. Full re-indexing is separate — we will not regenerate embeddings without your sign-off.
- Backups and cold storage: we will include a backup-scope section in the manifest and coordinate deletion where Redwood has retention control; for third-party backups we will provide recommendations to coordinate with your infra team.

If that timeline isn't workable, say so and we’ll compress where we can.

—Marissa
Senior Customer Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Elena — thanks for raising. A few compliance checkpoints from my side before we execute:
1) Scope sign-off: the erasure_manifest.csv must be reviewed by FastBank security/compliance and contain a signed acceptance to proceed.
2) SLA exception: full historical purges (start date 2025-01-01) require Escalation Approval for a destructive run; I'll prepare the exception memo.
3) Audit trail: we will capture signed operator IDs and system checksums; these will be stored in our audit ledger and included in the proof bundle.

I can provide the Escalation Approval memo within 24 hours once you confirm the customer point-of-contact who will sign the manifest.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Privacy & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
